WITH pay AS (

 FROM haoshen_ods.charge_order_info WHERE log_time>='${stat_date}' AND log_time<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY user_id

)
SELECT '${stat_date}' AS log_date,u.user_id,u.agent_id,u.reg_date,

 CASE WHEN u.last_login_date>='${stat_date}' AND u.last_login_date<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active_snapshot_flag,

 CASE WHEN u.first_infull_time>='${stat_date}' AND u.first_infull_time<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS first_pay_flag,
 p.payment_rows,p.distinct_orders,p.cash_amount,p.charge_coins

LEFT JOIN pay p ON u.user_id=p.user_id
LEFT JOIN login_event l ON u.user_id=l.user_id
LEFT JOIN haoshen_ods.bs_user_id b ON u.user_id=b.user_id

 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.reg_date>=DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY)
 AND t.reg_date<DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY),INTERVAL 1 DAY)
 THEN t.user_id END) AS cohort_users,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.reg_date>=DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY)
 AND t.reg_date<DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY),INTERVAL 1 DAY)
 AND t.last_login_date>='${stat_date}' AND t.last_login_date<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN t.user_id END) AS returned_users
 FROM offsets n LEFT JOIN haoshen_dwd.dwd_user_info_di t ON t.log_date='${stat_date}'
 WHERE '${stat_date}'<'${data_complete_before}'
 GROUP BY n.retention_day,n.offset_day
